citations.context: But give it 20 years. If we don't fight, if you're scared to be called racist, you're scared to be called Islamophobic, get over yourself, get over your pride, get over your reputation, put some put some courage on you, be strong and courageous, as God said to Joshua, and go and fight for your nation.
